diagnostics.message: `:resource.google_org_policy_policy.default` creates project-level org policies (name/parent derived from `local.project.project_id`) but has no dependency at all on `:resource.google_project_service.project_services`. Creating an org policy requires the Org Policy API (`orgpolicy.googleapis.com`) to be enabled on the project, and its name/parent are built from plain strings, so no reference establishes the ordering. During destroy, the API can also be disabled before the policies are deleted. Add `depends_on = [google_project_service.project_services]`.

`:resource.google_project_iam_audit_config.default` configures audit logging per service, but `service = each.key` comes straight from `var.logging_data_access` — no attribute reference and no `depends_on` links it to `:resource.google_project_service.project_services`. The audited service's API must already be enabled (and must not be disabled before the audit config is removed on destroy). Add `depends_on = [google_project_service.project_services]`.

`:resource.google_monitoring_monitored_project.primary` adds the project to external metrics scopes (`each.value` from `var.metric_scopes`), but nothing ties it to `:resource.google_project_service.project_services`. Registering a monitored project requires the Monitoring API enabled in the project and must not run concurrently with / after API teardown. Add `depends_on = [google_project_service.project_services]`.
